title: Lazarillo de Tormes, Islamic influences and Spanish perspectives
core_idea: Through a literature review of Lazarillo de Tormes, the article analyzes the protagonist in a period of social change and aims to demonstrate how Islamic/Arabic cultural influences, themes of honour and shame, and religious prejudice are embedded in the picaresque narrative of contemporary Spain.
tldr: A literature-review study that examines Lazarillo de Tormes to explore its protagonist and how Islamic/Arabic influences, honour–shame dynamics, and religious prejudice reflect social change in early modern Spain.
